_comment: How a tenant admin sets, rotates and revokes the per-tenant secret that signs WebChat identity tokens (design D8). No new route: the existing AdminOnly GET/PUT /api/v1/admin/channels/{channel} (ChannelConfigEndpoints.cs:14-18) with the merge semantics of living spec channel-credential-config (omitted or blank keeps, value replaces, null removes). WebChat gains a DECLARED credential schema (it has none today, ChannelCredentialSchema.cs:70-74), so an unknown key is refused with the existing `unknown-credential-key`. A secret value is NEVER returned: responses carry only {key, isSet}; the audit record carries key names only. The console generates the secret in the browser (32 random bytes, base64url) and shows it once for the admin to copy into the site's signer; the Platform never generates or echoes it. Rotation is server-side: replacing identityTokenSecret moves the old value into identityTokenSecretPrevious and stamps identityTokenSecretReplacedAt, and the verifier accepts the previous secret for 24 h after that stamp so the site can deploy the new one. Sending null for identityTokenSecretPrevious revokes it at once (a leaked secret). Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names and codes VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

schema._note: already used by the console (Web src/admin/channels/channel-fields.ts:91-102); declared SECRET so values stored today (wrapped at rest, because WebChat had no schema and every key was secret) still read back unchanged. Shown as isSet only, exactly as today
32..512 characters; the HMAC key is its UTF-8 bytes

schema.writableByAdmin: never: a PUT that names it, with a value, blank or null, is refused with server-managed-credential-key; it is cleared only together with identityTokenSecretPrevious
schema._note: server-written ISO 8601 UTC instant of the last replacement; the grace is 24 h from it. Declared secret (wrapped at rest) so a rollback to code that treats every WebChat key as secret reads it back unchanged (review P3, 2026-11-04). A missing or unparseable value means the previous secret is never tried (fail closed; fixtures/webchat-identity-token.v1.json)

rotate.case: the admin replaces the secret at 2026-11-04T09:00:00Z; the old one stays valid for 24 h
rotate._note: a PUT whose identityTokenSecret equals the stored value is not a rotation: nothing moves and changed_keys does not name it

revokePrevious.case: the old secret leaked: end its grace now

disableLevel2.case: remove the secret: every later token is refused with identity-token-not-configured and sessions fall back to level 1
disableLevel2._note: removing identityTokenSecret alone keeps no grace: a removal is not a rotation, and the verifier never uses a previous secret without a current one

refusals.case: secret shorter than 32 characters (or longer than 512)
a value for a server-written key
a PUT that names identityTokenSecretReplacedAt directly (any value, null included)
a key outside the WebChat schema (existing code)
caller is not an admin (existing policy)

fields.credentials[].key: string, the schema key names above, in schema order, then any stored key outside the schema
fields.credentials[].isSet: boolean, whether the key holds a non-blank value; the value itself is never returned
fields.error: `weak-identity-token-secret`, `server-managed-credential-key` (new, ErrorDetailResponse with details = key names) or the existing `unknown-credential-key`
